title: Supervene
summary: SUPERVE'NE, verb intransitive [Latin supervenio; super and venio.] 1. To come upon as something extraneous. Such a mutual gravitation can never supervene to matter, unless impressed by divine power. 2

inlines.v: SUPERVE'NE, verb intransitive [Latin supervenio; super and venio.] 1. To come upon as something extraneous. Such a mutual gravitation can never supervene to matter, unless impressed by divine power. 2. To come upon; to happen to.
